name: dev-skills
description: A collection of Claude skills for developer documentation and workflow tasks.

plugins.name: docs-consistency-check
plugins.description: Audits the prose layer of a project (READMEs, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, templates, manifests, changelogs, installers) for cross-file drift and content restated where it should be referenced.

plugins.name: subtract-first
plugins.description: Forces the subtractive option to be considered before code is added: three searches (reuse, extend, subtract) run at implementation time, before a new file, abstraction or dependency appears.

plugins.name: work-report
plugins.description: Writes WORK-REPORT.md, a standardized self-report of a session's work that a reviewer or a later session reads instead of re-deriving intent from the diff.
